                    name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    price REAL NOT NULL,
                    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    discount_rate REAL NOT NULL
                )
            )");

            // Insert products

                    + std::to_string(p.price) + ", "
                    + std::to_string(p.quantity) + ", "
